nodes.label: Verity Design System Rules

nodes.label: Semantic Theme Tokens
nodes.description: text-text-primary/secondary/tertiary and bg-surface tokens that resolve per light/dark mode.

nodes.label: Verity README
nodes.description: Next.js 16.2.10 / React 19.2.4 Factory Operating System backed by Prisma on PostgreSQL; canonical docs live under docs/.

nodes.label: Verity Platform
nodes.description: Universal operations platform for service and production businesses; multi-tenant Factory Operating System.

nodes.label: Site
nodes.description: A physical place belonging to a client where work happens; carries the SLA response hours stamped onto tickets at creation.

nodes.label: Verity User Guide
nodes.description: Single-source user guide rendered at /guide; setup order, master data, sites, SLA semantics, modular entitlements.

nodes.label: Phone + 4-digit PIN login
nodes.description: Every person who logs in gets a phone number and a 4-digit PIN; the phone number is the username.

nodes.label: Module Entitlements
nodes.description: A workspace only shows the modules its organisation is entitled to; missing screens mean the module is off.
